blocks.title: Osmoregulation
blocks.text: Osmoregulation woh amal hai jis se jandar gird ke mahol ke halaat se qata nazar pani aur hal shuda maddon ka mustahkam andarooni tawazun (equilibrium) qaim rakhta hai.

Bohat se samundari jandar kisi qaboo ke nizam ke baghair osmosis se guzarte hain, kyunke un ke cells ka osmotic pressure samundar jaisa hai. Doosre jandaron ko apna andarooni pani aur minerals ka tawazun qaim rakhne ke liye faal taur par pani ya namak hasil karna, rakhna ya nikalna parta hai.

items: Hypotonic mahlool mein solute ki concentration cell ke andar se kam hoti hai, to pani osmosis se cell mein aata hai aur woh phoolta hai.
Hypertonic mahlool mein solute ki concentration cell ke andar se zyada hoti hai, to pani bahar jata hai aur cell sukarta hai; pode ke cell mein pani ka yeh ziyan plasmolysis hai.
Isotonic mahlool mein solute ki concentration cell ke andar jaisi hoti hai, to cell aur us ke mahol ke darmiyan pani ki koi khalis harkat nahin hoti.

blocks.alt: Teen podon ke cells. Hypotonic mahlool mein neele teer andar ki taraf hain aur jhilli deewar se kas kar lagi hai. Isotonic mahlool mein teer dono taraf hain aur cell apni shakal rakhta hai. Hypertonic mahlool mein teer bahar ki taraf hain aur jhilli aur mawad deewar se sukar kar alag ho gaye hain.
blocks.caption: Hypotonic, isotonic aur hypertonic mahlool mein pode ka cell (Figure 8.16 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Hypotonic mahlool mein pani osmosis se aata hai, cell phool kar turgid hota hai, aur deewar use phatne se rokti hai. Isotonic mahlool mein pani ki koi khalis harkat nahin aur cell apni shakal rakhta hai. Hypertonic mahlool mein pani nikalta hai, protoplast deewar se sukar kar alag ho jata hai aur cell plasmolysed ho jata hai.

blocks.text: Pode aabi (aquatic), motadil, sakht khushk aur namkeen (saline) maskanon (habitats) mein rehte hain aur tarteeb-war hydrophytes, mesophytes, xerophytes aur halophytes kehlate hain.

Hydrophytes khaas osmotic tabdeeliyon se aabi mahol, samundari aur meethe pani, ke liye dhale hain. Samundari hydrophytes namkeen (hypertonic) halaat mein rehte hain jahan pani un ke cells se nikalne ka rujhan rakhta hai; yeh zaid namak salt glands se nikalte hain, pani rakhne ke liye proline, glycine betaine aur sugars jaise organic solutes bana kar apna andarooni osmotic potential barhate hain, moti cuticles rakhte hain jo pani ka ziyan kam karti hain, aur zyada namak bardasht karne wali halophytic khusoosiyat dikhate hain. Meethe pani ke hydrophytes hypotonic mahol mein rehte hain jahan pani musalsal un ke cells mein aata hai; yeh zaid pani hydathodes ya vacuoles jaisi banawaton se nikalte hain, halke mahol mein osmotic tawazun rakhne ke liye potassium aur calcium jaise zaroori ions faal taur par jazb karte hain, patli ya ghair-maujood cuticles rakhte hain jo pani ke tabadle ko asaan karti hain, aur aksar chhoti jarein rakhte hain, nutrients aur pani seedha pani se jazb karte hain. Misalein water lily, kanwal (lotus), samundari ghaas (seaweeds) aur tape grass hain.

Mesophytes motadil mahol mein rehte hain jo na bohat khushk hai na bohat geela, aisi mitti pasand karte hain jis mein pani bhara na ho aur namak aur nami motadil ho. In ki achhi tarah bani jarein aur shoots aur mukammal vascular nizam hai aur inhen koi khaas tabdeeli nahin chahiye. In ke patte chapte, chaure aur sabz hain jin ki satah par stomata hain. Misalein gulab, tamatar aur daisy hain.

Xerophytes khushk halaat mein zinda rehne ke liye dhale hain, pani ka ziyan kam karne aur pani zakheera karne ki khaas tabdeeliyon ke saath. Pani zakheera karne wale pode succulents hain, jin ke gudedar (fleshy) tane zaroorat par istemal ke liye pani rakhte hain. Doosri tabdeeliyon mein pani ka ziyan kam karne ke liye patton par momi tahein, khushk daur mein patton ka girna, aur dhoop moassar taur par jazb karne ke liye patton ka murna ya rukh badalna shamil hain. Misalein kantedar darakht, sehrai genda (desert marigold) aur blue agave hain.

Halophytes NaCl, MgCl2 aur MgSO4 jaise namak ki zyada concentration wali namkeen mitti, ya namkeen pani, mein rehte hain; wahan sirf wohi pode ug sakte hain jo itni namak ki concentration bardasht karein. In ke patte gudedar aur kabhi tane bhi gudedar hote hain, aur kuch mein patte kanton mein badal jate hain. Misalein sea arrowgrass aur sea lavender hain.

blocks.title: Mangroves
blocks.text: Samundar ke kinare daldali jagahon par ugne wale halophytes ek khaas nabatat banate hain jise mangrove ya tidal woodland kehte hain; inhen helophilous halophytes bhi kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Meethe pani ka ek poda aur ek seaweed har ek ko musalsal ek osmotic masla darpesh hai. Har ek ka masla aur ek tabdeeli batayein.
blocks.explanation: Meethe pani ka poda hypotonic pani mein hai, to pani us ke cells mein aata rehta hai; woh zaid pani hydathodes ya vacuoles se nikalta aur tawazun ke liye ions faal taur par jazb karta hai. Seaweed hypertonic samundari pani mein hai, to pani nikalne ka rujhan rakhta hai; woh zaid namak salt glands se nikalta aur pani rakhne ko proline jaise organic solutes banata hai.

items: Osmoregulation andarooni pani aur solutes ko mustahkam rakhti hai. Hypotonic mahol cell ko phulata, hypertonic sukarta (podon mein plasmolysis), isotonic jaisa ka waisa rakhta hai.

Hydrophytes: samundari namak nikalte, organic solutes banate aur moti cuticles rakhte hain; meethe pani wale pani nikalte, ions jazb karte, patli cuticles aur chhoti jarein rakhte hain. Mesophytes ko koi khaas tabdeeli nahin chahiye. Xerophytes gudedar tanon mein pani rakhte aur mom, patton ke girne aur murne se ziyan kam karte hain. Halophytes gudedar patton aur tanon se namak bardasht karte hain; mangroves kinare ke halophytes hain.
